title: A Drifting Life
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yoshihiro Tatsumi's autobiographical memoir follows his stand-in, Hiroshi, from August 1945 to June 1960 as he grows up in post-war Osaka. Hiroshi faces his father's money troubles, his parents' failing marriage and his jealous brother's poor health while chasing a career in the competitive manga industry. It traces his part in creating 'gekiga', a grittier, more literary style of comics for adults.
life_message: A life devoted to one's craft, pursued with persistence through hardship, gives it meaning.
